title: Appointment and Cancellation Policy
brief: How to book, move and cancel appointments at Brindlemoor Family Clinic. States the 24-hour notice rule, the 25 dollar late cancellation fee, the three missed appointments in 12 months rule (then 3 months of front-desk-only booking) and how to rebook through the patient portal.

title: New Patient Registration
brief: How a new patient registers with the clinic online or at the front desk. States that registration takes about 15 minutes, needs photo identification and the Brindlemoor Health Number, and that a first visit can be booked once registration is approved within 2 business days.

title: Patient FAQ
brief: Frequently asked questions: hours (Monday to Friday 8:00 to 18:00, Saturday 9:00 to 13:00 at north only), booking, walk-ins at north (8:00 to 10:00) and eastgate (16:00 to 17:30), what to bring, and why the chat assistant cannot give medical advice.

title: Billing FAQ
brief: Fees for uninsured patients: 85 dollars for a standard visit and 130 dollars for an extended visit, the 25 dollar late cancellation fee, payment plans of up to 6 monthly instalments for balances over 200 dollars, and the monthly statement cycle issued on the first business day of each month.

title: Privacy and Records Request Policy
brief: Who may request records (the patient or a person with written consent), how requests are made through the patient portal or front desk with identity checks, the answer within 10 business days, and that records are never shared by chat, phone message or email.

title: Vaccination Clinic Guide
brief: Seasonal flu clinic from 2026-10-05 to 2026-12-18 at north and eastgate, travel vaccine consultation lead time of 6 weeks, tetanus boosters, what to expect after a vaccine, and a 15-minute wait after the injection.

title: Lab Tests Guide
brief: Lab tests at the riverside site, lab hours 07:30 to 12:00 on weekdays, fasting for 10 hours with water allowed, a clinician request needed for most panels, and results in the patient portal 3 to 5 business days after the test.

title: Physiotherapy Programme
brief: The 8-week rehabilitation programme at the north site, an initial assessment of 60 minutes, follow-up sessions of 45 minutes, no referral needed, waitlist rules, and what to wear and bring.

title: Mental Health Support Services
brief: Counselling intake of 50 minutes at riverside and eastgate, booked only through the patient portal, typical waitlist of about 2 weeks, short-term counselling of up to 6 sessions, stress and sleep workshops, and a note that in a crisis people should contact emergency services.

title: Site Directory and Accessibility
brief: The three sites: north in Harbour District, riverside in Willowbank and eastgate in Eastgate Quarter, with parking details (free car park of 40 spaces at north, two hours free on Willowbank Row at riverside, paid garage at 3 dollars an hour at eastgate), step-free access, quiet rooms and hearing loops.

title: Prescription Renewal Policy
brief: Renewals are requested only through the patient portal, take 7 business days, need a medication review every 12 months, and are never handled in chat or by phone message. Urgent shortages should be raised with the front desk.

title: After-Hours and Urgent Care Guidance
brief: General guidance on what to do outside clinic hours: use the nurse advice line through the patient portal for non-urgent questions, contact emergency services for chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding or thoughts of self-harm, and when to wait for a next-day appointment. No medical advice beyond directing people.

title: Patient Rights and Responsibilities
brief: The rights to privacy, respectful care, an interpreter and a second opinion, and the responsibilities to keep contact details up to date, arrive 10 minutes before an appointment and give 24 hours notice of cancellations.

title: Interpreter and Accessibility Services
brief: Free interpreter services booked at least 3 business days ahead, sign language on request with 5 business days notice, large-print and easy-read materials, quiet rooms, and how to request an accommodation through the patient portal.
